# RMS Copilot entry point

Read and follow root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before working if it is not already in context. Its safety and automatic verification requirements apply in VS Code, CLI and cloud sessions.

Load only the relevant guidance from the [task reference index](../docs/agent-reference/README.md). Select one specialist directly; use `rms-workflow` for cross-scope tasks. If custom-agent invocation or skill discovery is unavailable, read the selected definition/SKILL.md and work locally; report capabilities accurately.

For simple questions, answer directly. For clear, bounded changes, follow the shortest safe path to the requested result and its narrowest required check; avoid routine narration, repeated exploration, and unnecessary delegation. Never skip mandatory safety or verification, and report only what was actually completed and checked.

Keep supported repository discovery settings; do not change models, disable instructions or exclude relevant source to reduce usage. Cloud sessions need the intended instructions in their checkout. See [client setup and usage comparison](../docs/COPILOT_WORKFLOW.md); actual discovery/usage requires client confirmation.
